info.title: Home Heating API
info.description: Contract between the heating service and the Android app. Both sides build against this document; change it only by agreement. All times are ISO-8601 with offset in the service's time zone. Temperatures are °C in 0.5 steps. Live updates: WebSocket /ws (bearer token) sends JSON messages of type LiveEvent; WebSocket /ws/power (admins only) sends LivePower. Energy access: admins, and members an admin gave it (User.energy), may read /api/dashboard, /api/power, /api/energy/history and /ws/power; other members get 403. Room access: admins (and the service token) use every route. A member sees and controls only the rooms an admin gave them (User.rooms); any /api/rooms/{id} or /api/zones/{zoneId} route on another room answers 404. Members get 403 on /api/house, /api/groups, GET /api/status, /api/holiday, /api/valves, /api/sensors, /api/meters, /api/energy/areas, /api/settings/energy, /api/admin, and on creating, renaming, deleting rooms or assigning valves and sensors.

bearer.description: A session token from /api/auth/login or /api/auth/setup, or the HEATING_API_TOKEN service token (admin).

Event.description: One MQTT message. payload is the JSON itself when json is true, else the text

next.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last

dropped.description: Events dropped when the write queue went over 10,000

rooms.description: Ids of every room this user can see now; every room for an admin

lastSeen.description: GET /api/admin/users only: last request with any of their sessions (written at most once a minute)

activeNow.description: GET /api/admin/users only: a request in the last 5 minutes

sessions.description: GET /api/admin/users only: sessions not signed out or expired

energy.description: May read the Energy tab (dials, history chart, totals): always true for an admin; members only once an admin gives it

UserSession.description: One sign-in on one device. No token or address is kept. Tokens from before sessions were kept show as device 'Earlier sign-in'

signedOutAt.description: When it was signed out, or expired; null while live

current.description: The session the caller is using

token.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Valid 180 days.

Override.description: Someone turned the valve knob; holds until the next schedule block.

Zone.description: Grouped room: one zone whose id is the room id. Independent room: one zone per valve, id '<roomId>:<valve>'.

target.description: Effective target now; null when off

mode.description: Grouped: the zone's mode. Independent: first zone's mode.

current.description: The room sensor's temperature when it is online, else the average of all online valves in the room

heating.description: Any valve in the room heating

temperatureSource.description: sensor while an online sensor measures the room

current.description: Average current temperature of its rooms that have one, 1 dp

target.description: Shared target when every room agrees, else null

heating.description: Every room in the group heating (false when it has no rooms)

heatingRooms.description: Ids of its rooms that are heating, in group order

BoostSettings.description: What a boost heats to when no target is given, and where the apps start their boost picker. Default 22.0. PUT takes defaultTarget; 400 unless it is a number from 5.0 to 30.0 in 0.5 steps

EnergyArea.description: A named thing with meters and no valves, such as Lights. Not a room: it has no heating

id.description: From the name it was created with, such as garage-office; a rename keeps it

wholeMeter.description: The meter (clamp) that measures all of the area; null when none

overlaps.description: Ids of the areas it shares a circuit with, both ways. Figures are not changed: the shared use cannot be measured

EnergySettings.description: Prices in the currency's minor unit (pence). Defaults 11.0, 30.0, 12.0 kW, 27.0, 50.0, GBP. PUT takes any subset of the price fields, currency and electricityMeter (null clears it); 400 for a negative price, a boiler rate of 0 or over 100 kW, an unknown currency code, or a meter that is not discovered

boilerAverageKw.description: Average burn rate; gas kWh is estimated as boiler hours times this

electricityMeter.description: Friendly name of the house electricity meter

currency.description: ISO 4217 code every cost is in, e.g. GBP (default) or EUR

notices.description: e.g. 'Main Clamp was removed from Zigbee2MQTT'; cleared when a meter is chosen

dailyKwhTarget.description: kWh a day the household aims to use on the house meter; null (default) for none. Over 0 and at most 1000, else 400

syncPricesWithBright.description: The four prices follow the Bright tariff, fetched every day; while on, PUT changing a price gets 400. true without a Bright account gets 400

brightAvailable.description: Whether a Bright account is set up to sync prices from

Meter.description: A Zigbee2MQTT device (clamp or smart plug) that exposes energy and power

stale.description: No reading for 30 minutes: its use is unknown, not zero

inUse.description: It is the house electricity meter

monitored.description: Its use is monitored, as part of the house meter's, never added to it

room.description: Id of the room this monitored device is in; null when in no room

area.description: Id of the energy area this monitored plug is in; null when in none. A plug is in one room or one area at most

measures.description: Id of the energy area this meter measures as its whole-area meter; null when none

reportsEnergy.description: False for a meter reporting power but no energy total: it can only measure an energy area, and is never listed as waiting to be set up

device.description: The Zigbee2MQTT device the meter is on: its own name, or the two-clamp meter it is one clamp of

clamp.description: A or B for one clamp of a two-clamp meter (named '<device> A'); null otherwise

reversed.description: The clamp reads backwards (fitted the wrong way round); its use is still counted

label.description: The name an admin gave it, else its Zigbee2MQTT name

missingMinutes.description: Minutes with no record (service down or meter stale)

targetDeltaKwh.description: electricityKwh minus the daily target (today: the share of it gone); null with no target or house meter

gasEstimatedKwh.description: The part of gasKwh estimated from boiler hours: all of it for time the gas meter has not reported

EnergyTarget.description: expectedKwh is the daily target for each day of the period, today's only for the share of today gone. deltaKwh = usedKwh - expectedKwh: below 0 is under target

kwh.description: The target for the whole period: days times dailyKwhTarget

usedKwh.description: Recorded so far; only what was recorded when incomplete

deltaCost.description: deltaKwh at the electricity price, in the minor unit

projectedKwh.description: Use by the end of the period at the rate so far; null in its first 30 minutes

EnergyDashboard.description: Costs in the currency's minor unit (pence) at the current prices, worked out when read. Electricity fields are null without a house meter, and totalCost then counts gas only

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the costs are in

devices.description: Monitored devices, sorted by name. Already part of electricityKwh and totalCost: shown as "of which", never added

rooms.description: Rooms with plug use in the period, sorted by name: each plug's use counts in the room it was in when it was recorded, so moving a plug never moves its past use. Part of devices, so never added to electricityKwh or totalCost

everythingElse.description: House electricity no monitored plug or energy area accounts for: the house minus each whole-area meter, and minus each plug not behind one. Null without a house meter

areas.description: Energy areas, by name. Of which the house's, never added to anything

target.description: House electricity against the daily target; null with no target or no house meter

gasEstimatedKwh.description: The part of gasKwh estimated from boiler hours: all of it for time the gas meter has not reported

gasMeteredTo.description: The end of the last half-hour the smart gas meter has reported; null with no meter readings

gasBurnRateKw.description: The boiler's burn rate (kW) the gas estimate uses

gasBurnRateFrom.description: meter: the gas meter's measured rate over its last 7 days; setting: boilerAverageKw

EverythingElse.description: electricityKwh minus all monitored plugs, in rooms or not, never below 0. Part of electricityKwh, so never added to totalCost

cost.description: Minor units at the electricity price

missingMinutes.description: The longer of the house meter's minutes with no reading and the minutes any monitored plug had none

incomplete.description: True when the house meter or any monitored plug is incomplete

sharedCircuits.description: Pairs of area names that share a circuit: this reads low by whatever both measure

at.description: The end of its five minutes, or the start of its hour or day

watts.description: Average power; null with no reading, and before plug power was kept

kwh.description: Use recorded in the point; null with no reading (not known, not 0)

cost.description: Minor units at the electricity price; no standing charge

incomplete.description: A reading is missing, so the figures are only what was recorded

points.description: Only its use recorded in this room

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the costs are in

earliest.description: The room's first sample; null when it has none

room.description: The sum of the plugs at the time, in the room each was in when recorded, including plugs moved out since

plugs.description: The plugs in the room now, sorted by name

AreaUsage.description: An energy area over time, in the shape of RoomUsage

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the costs are in

earliest.description: The area's first sample, by its clamp or a plug; null when it has none

room.description: The whole area: at each five minutes its clamp if recorded then (a clamp with no reading leaves the point incomplete, never filled in from its plugs), else the sum of the plugs in it then

plugs.description: The plugs in the area now, sorted by name, with what each used while in it

overlaps.description: Names of the areas it shares a circuit with: some of its use is also counted in them

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the costs are in

room.description: The house less all monitored plugs, never below 0

at.description: Start of the bar's hour or day

kwh.description: Use of the room's plugs recorded in the bar; null when none had a reading in it (no use known, not 0 kWh)

incomplete.description: A plug in the room had no reading for some of the bar, so kwh is only what was recorded

RoomPlugs.description: Today so far, from the plug samples recorded in this room (as Dashboard rooms), so a plug moved out today still counts here. Part of the house meter's use, so never added to anything

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the costs are in

cost.description: Minor units at the electricity price; no standing charge

missingMinutes.description: Minutes any of the room's plugs had no reading, counted once

plugs.description: The plugs in the room now, sorted by name, each with only its use recorded in this room

power.description: W now; null while offline or stale

offline.description: When it had no reading today

offlineSince.description: Set while the plug is offline now (Zigbee2MQTT says so, or 30 minutes with no reading): when it went. It is then also incomplete

totalStuckSince.description: Set while the plug's power readings say it should have used at least 0.05 kWh since its energy total last changed (the total moves in 0.01 kWh steps): when the total last changed. It is then also incomplete. Never set while offline now

AreaEnergy.description: An energy area over the period. While its whole-area meter recorded, the area is the clamp's figure and its plugs are part of it; with no clamp it is the sum of its plugs. Of which the house's; standing charges are never split onto areas

plugs.description: Each plug's use while in the area

rest.description: What the clamp measured beyond its plugs, never below 0; null with no clamp

overlaps.description: Names of the areas it shares a circuit with: some of its use is also counted in them

cost.description: Minor units at the electricity price

missingMinutes.description: Minutes any of the room's plugs had no reading, counted once when several were stale at the same time

incomplete.description: True when any of the room's plugs is incomplete

offlineSince.description: Set while the plug is offline now (Zigbee2MQTT says so, or 30 minutes with no reading): when it went. It is then also incomplete

totalStuckSince.description: Set while the plug's power readings say it should have used at least 0.05 kWh since its energy total last changed (the total moves in 0.01 kWh steps): when the total last changed. It is then also incomplete. Never set while offline now

DaySchedule.description: 1-6 blocks, first at 00:00, increasing start times

active.description: false while waiting for a future start

boilerOverride.description: Set while an admin has forced the boiler off. Absent or null otherwise

BoilerOverride.description: An admin forced the boiler off. While it is set no zone calls for heat, valves are held off and heat demand is false; the zones' own settings are untouched. Clients show a notice to everyone and, to admins, a button to turn the boiler back on

by.description: Username of the admin, or admin when the service token did it

BoilerState.description: What the boiler is doing. heating: a zone calls and demand is on. cycling: no zone calls but demand stays on until its minimum run ends. resting: a zone calls but demand stays off until its minimum rest ends. idle: nothing calls and demand is off.

until.description: When cycling or resting ends; null otherwise

target.description: Effective target; absent on whole-house points

to.description: null for the state the boiler is in now

house.description: Median of the rooms' temperatures at each time

boiler.description: Boiler states overlapping from..to, oldest first

at.description: Start of the five minutes, hour, day or month

cost.description: Minor units at today's electricity price

incomplete.description: Samples missing or without a reading: the figures are only what was recorded

targetKwh.description: The daily target times the point's days, for range month (a day each) and year (a month each); otherwise null

HouseHistory.description: The house meter's use for the history chart, its points lined up with the calendar in the household's timezone

earliest.description: The first house sample: how far back the chart can go

cost.description: Minor units at today's electricity price

since.description: When the broker connection dropped; only when disconnected

reason.description: Why it dropped or the last retry failed; only when disconnected

RuleCondition.description: One test on the payload; all of a rule's conditions must hold

field.description: Path in the JSON payload, dots for nesting (contact, action, color.x). "value" is the whole payload of a message that is not a JSON object, as a number when it reads as one.

operator.description: !=, >= and <= are accepted for ≠, ≥ and ≤. A missing field never matches.

value.description: A string, number or boolean; not used by exists

from.description: HH:mm in the house's time zone

to.description: HH:mm; before from means the window crosses midnight

sendSummary.description: Hold the matches and send one summary when quiet hours end ("Front door opened 3 times overnight") instead of dropping them

trigger.description: changes to: fire when the conditions start to match on a topic; is: fire on every matching message

title.description: May use {{topic}}, {{topic.last}}, {{device}}, {{payload}}, {{value}}, {{payload.some.field}}; a missing field fills in as ?. An unknown placeholder is a 400.

by.description: Username of the admin who made it

pausedUntil.description: Set while the rule is paused for firing 30 times in 10 minutes

pausedUntilLocal.description: pausedUntil as HH:mm in the house's time zone ("Paused until 19:10")

lastSentAt.description: When the rule last sent a notification, from its history (kept 30 days); null if it has not

setUp.description: A rule already does this: same topic and first condition

text.description: For display, such as "sent to 3 people"

result.description: would send, conditions not met: contact is true, or no change

events.description: The last 20 events on the rule's topic, newest first

notify.description: me: the admin setting it up; everyone: everyone with energy access

AreaAlertView.description: An area's notification; all null with none

by.description: Username of the admin who set it up

mine.description: Whether the caller set it up

DeliveryEvent.description: The event that caused a delivery, as its rule saw it

Delivery.description: One notification for one person, queued then sent to each of their phones and browsers

source.description: What sent it: a rule's name, "Area notification" or "Heating alert"

sentTo.description: The phones and browsers that took it

event.description: What caused it; null for heating alerts, whose source says what did

failed.description: Failed deliveries in all, whatever the filter

GasDay.description: A day of the smart gas meter, half-hour by half-hour

cost.description: kwh at the gas price, in the minor unit; no standing charge

previous.description: The nearest earlier day with readings

next.description: The nearest later day with readings

measuredBoilerKw.description: The meter's kWh over the boiler's burning hours on the 7 days up to the latest whole day; null with under 5 hours

boilerAverageKw.description: The setting the gas estimate uses

cost.description: kwh at the gas price, in the minor unit; no standing charge

previousKwh.description: The day before's kWh; null with no readings that day

EnergyTotals.description: The house's use for the dashboard's odometer and trip counter. Calendar periods in the household's timezone; a sample at 00:00 counts in the day before

pencePerKwh.description: Today's electricity price in minor units

yesterdaySoFar.description: Yesterday from 00:00 to this time; null with no samples yesterday

gas.description: The smart gas meter's latest whole day; null until it has reported one

day.description: The household's date that today is for, in the household's timezone

dayEndsAt.description: The next midnight in the household's timezone, when day ends and today starts again from 0

at.description: The service's time these totals were worked out

EnergyFlow.description: Where the house's energy went over a dashboard period (GET /api/energy/flow?period=today|yesterday|week|month), for a Sankey diagram.

estimated.description: Shared out (gas between rooms by hours calling), not measured

PowerSummary.description: What the dials need besides the live readings (GET /api/power).

bands.description: Null with under a day of readings in the last 7 days: show one neutral colour

green.description: W. Green up to here: the median house reading 00:00-05:00

red.description: W. Red from here: the 90th percentile of all house readings; amber between

recent.description: House readings of the last 30 minutes, oldest first

todayPeak.description: The highest five-minute average house power since midnight (a sample at 00:00 counts in the day before); null before today's first sample

parts.description: What was using it then, largest first: rooms (their plugs then), areas (clamp when recorded, else plugs), devices in neither, and else (the remainder, never below 0)

id.description: Room or area id, or the device's meter name; null for else

LivePower.description: Message on the WebSocket /ws/power (bearer token, admin only): one on connect and one on every house or monitored plug reading, plus one when the house reading goes stale.

watts.description: House W; null with no reading in the last 2 minutes

at.description: When the house meter was last read

rooms.description: Rooms with monitored plugs, by name

watts.description: Sum of its plugs reporting now; null when none is

elseWatts.description: House W no room, device or energy area accounts for (an area counts once: its clamp, or its plugs when it has none), never below 0; null while watts is

areas.description: Energy areas' power now: the whole-area meter's (null while it has no live reading), else the sum of its plugs reporting

LiveEvent.description: WebSocket message. room.updated carries the full Room; room.deleted carries roomId; status.updated carries Status; valve.updated carries Valve; groups.updated carries every Group; sensor.updated carries Sensor; access.updated (no payload) tells a user an admin changed their rooms or admin rights, so the app fetches /api/auth/me and /api/rooms again; boiler.override carries BoilerOverrideStatus whenever an admin turns the boiler off or back on. Members get room.updated and room.deleted only for rooms they can see, boiler.override, and no status, valve, groups or sensor events.
